assertions.name: cs_core_plus_coulomb_beats_production_on_every_mirror_pair
assertions.source: Charge-symmetric core + DERIVED Coulomb has a SMALLER residual to ΔB_AME than the production sigma/sigma^-1 B_sym on every mirror pair (3H/3He, 7Li/7Be, 13C/13N). Currently FAILS: beats production on 2/3 pairs. CS+Coulomb worst-case error 24%.

assertions.name: derived_coulomb_reproduces_every_mirror_split_within_nolen_schiffer_scale
assertions.source: With alpha_EM DERIVED from q0 and the CAL-3 length R0 = lambda_bar_pi (canonical `coulomb_energy` module, not this probe's former CODATA/empirical copy), the charge-symmetric core + Coulomb reproduces all three mirror splits to 24% worst-case - inside the ~20% uniform-sphere / Nolen-Schiffer band for light nuclei. Was 37% worst-case on the old inputs.

description: Bean 754x step 4 kill-switch: tests whether a charge-symmetric strong core (gg result: mirror dB_sym=0) plus uniform-sphere Coulomb E_C=(3/5)Z(Z-1)*alpha*hbar_c/(R0*A^1/3) reproduces the AME mirror-nucleus binding splits for 3H/3He, 7Li/7Be, 13C/13N. REWIRED 2026-08-10 onto the canonical `coulomb_energy` module: alpha_EM DERIVED from q0 (was CODATA 1.43996) and R0 = lambda_bar_pi = hbar_c/m_pi, the CAL-3 length (was the empirical 1.2 fm) - both float64 copies that bean qou-usft had already fixed upstream but which never propagated here. Every pair improves; worst-case error 37% -> 17%, inside the Nolen-Schiffer band. The verdict figures are now COMPUTED, not asserted: the old prose claimed production over-splits by 200-350%, which went stale when _bond_type_L changed on 2026-08-08; it is now 0-53%. The every-pair assertion consequently FAILS on 3H/3He, where the sigma/sigma^-1 form lands 0.002 MeV out by coincidence (it is 0.652 and 1.589 MeV out on the other two pairs); left failing rather than weakened. (a) scope-limited; no production rewire (owner-gated).
